rules.rule:
#### Documentation accuracy
Does every claim about behavior, commands, flags, defaults, file paths, and triggers match the code and configuration at this head? Cite the contradicting file:line for any mismatch.
A claim about branch protection, required checks, merge gating, or anything else that lives outside the repository is verified against the live API, not against another document.

#### One owner
Does the text restate a fact that already has an authoritative owner elsewhere (code doc comment, another doc)? Prefer a pointer over a copy.
When the text names an owner, open that owner: confirm it actually carries the fact, and grep for surviving copies of the same fact elsewhere - other docs AND code comments - because a change that declares single ownership without retiring the other copies has not achieved it.

#### Completeness
Does the change leave a stale statement elsewhere in the docs (grep for the old wording)? Check the whole repository, not the diff window: a consolidation typically leaves its worst copy standing outside the files it edited.
